name: p4-gi-area-restir-diag
command: env GI_SCENARIO=area-restir NMC_GPU_WAIT_S=900 node --input-type=module -e "const g=await import('./web/common/gpu-job.mjs'),j=await import('./web/common/page-job.mjs'),t=await import('./scripts/trace-first-pixel.mjs'),fs=await import('node:fs');const Q=[.1,.3,.5,.7,.9],L=function(s){console.log('diag: '+s)},O='out/global-illumination/area-restir-diag';const I={selectionId:'diag',attemptId:'diag',buildId:'diag',scenario:process.env.GI_SCENARIO,mode:'restir-still',width:1280,height:720,remainingMs:270000};let R=null,F=null;try{const p=await g.publishGpuPage('dist/global-illumination',{timeoutMs:300000});R=(await g.runGpuPageOp(p.pageRef,'run',I,{timeoutMs:300000,out:O})).result}catch(e){F=String(e);L('job failed: '+F);try{R=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(O+'/result.json','utf8')).result}catch(x){}};if(!R){L('FAIL: no result in '+O);process.exit(1)};L('adapter '+JSON.stringify(R.adapter)+' hardware '+R.hardware);const E=R.errors??{};for(const k of['console','page','gpu']){const m=new Map();for(const e of E[k]??[]){const s=String(e).slice(0,1200);m.set(s,(m.get(s)??0)+1)}L(k+' messages: '+(E[k]??[]).length);for(const[s,n]of m)L(k+' x'+n+': '+s)};const im=(R.images??[])[0];let B='no capture';if(im){const b=Buffer.from(im.data,'base64');B=j.blankCapture(b);const d=t.decodePng(b),H=Math.min(d.height,720),px=function(x,y){const o=(y*d.width+x)*d.channels;return d.data[o]+','+d.data[o+1]+','+d.data[o+2]};for(const v of Q)L('colour row '+Math.floor(v*H)+': '+Q.map(function(u){return 'rgb('+px(Math.floor(u*d.width),Math.floor(v*H))+')'}).join(' '));const c=new Set();for(let y=0;y<H;y+=4)for(let x=0;x<d.width;x+=4)c.add(px(x,y));L(c.size+' colours on a 4-px grid')};L('mask: not in the op result');const P=[];if((E.gpu??[]).length)P.push(E.gpu.length+' wgpu errors');if((E.page??[]).length)P.push('page errors');if(B!==null)P.push('blank: '+B);if(F!==null)P.push('job failed');if(P.length){L('FAIL: '+P.join('; '));process.exit(1)}L('ok: no wgpu error, frame not one flat colour')"
